purpose: Fresh synthetic lesson-delivery safety set, written after the scope-pairing design and frozen before its first run. A hook match is not a real-agent or cost result.

lessons.evidence: Partial refunds retain the original payment_id and subtract only the refunded amount from the captured balance.
lessons.text: A partial refund retains the original payment_id and subtracts only the refunded amount from the captured balance.
lessons.applies: reconciling partial refunds against captured payments in src/payments/refunds.ts

lessons.evidence: After a tenant role change, increment the cache generation before publishing the invalidation event.
lessons.text: After a tenant role change, increment the cache generation before publishing the invalidation event so old permissions are not reused.
lessons.applies: invalidating tenant cache entries after role changes in src/cache/tenant.ts

lessons.text: Audit CSV exports escape cells beginning with =, +, - or @ before download so spreadsheet apps cannot execute formulas.
lessons.applies: exporting audit CSV reports in src/audit/export.ts

lessons.evidence: Payment schema releases expand before app deploy and contract only after old workers drain.
lessons.text: Payment schema releases expand before the new app deploy and contract only after old workers drain.
lessons.applies: deploying payment database migrations during a release in deploy/migrate.ts
